t: This is a panel of stained glass that came from Steinfeld, in Germany, and is now in the Victoria and Albert Museum. It is credited to Gerhard Remisch, who lived from 1450 to 1520, so the glass is around five hundred years old. Stained glass was made to be seen with light passing through it, so look at how the colours and lines hold together. I don't have more about the scene it shows, so let the details of the glass speak for themselves.
